name: order_ldh
description: Orders a Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH) test. LDH is a non-specific marker of tissue damage found in many cells. Elevated in hemolysis, myocardial infarction, liver disease, malignancy, and pulmonary embolism.
when_to_use: Monitoring lymphoma or solid tumor treatment response
Pleural or peritoneal fluid analysis to determine exudate

args.clinical_indication: anemia with elevated reticulocyte count and low haptoglobin
